title: The Sandcastle at Bluewater Landing | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Brand-New Home!* 6-Passenger Golf Cart Included * 4 Bikes Included – Enjoy scenic rides along 30A and nearby bike trails* Private Outdoor Space * Walk to Village Boulevard – Enjoy nearby restaurants, shops, and local attractions
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Fabulous Brand-New Home!* 6-Passenger Golf Cart Included * 4 Bikes Included – Enjoy scenic rides along 30A and nearby bike trails* Private Outdoor Space * Walk to Village Boulevard – Enjoy nearby restaurants, shops, and local attractions* Close to Blue Mountain Beach – Experience the laid-back atmosphere and beautiful Gulf shoreline* Easy Access to 30A Bike Trails – Explore the scenic trails and charming coastal communities* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **Smart home technology is used to help ensure policy compliance and may include remotely monitored thermostats, door locks, a decibel meter, and video surveillance, including the front door.*Welcome to The Sandcastle at Bluewater Landing, a brand-new luxury home located in the highly desirable Blue Mountain Beach community! Offering a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience, this beautiful home features four bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and spacious accommodations for up to 10 guests. Designed with families and friends in mind, The Sandcastle features an open-concept layout with comfortable living and dining spaces, high-end finishes, and beautiful coastal-inspired décor. The fully stocked kitchen features stainless steel appliances and everything you need to prepare meals and gather together during your stay. When you're not out exploring, relax in your private outdoor space. It's the perfect setting for morning coffee, an afternoon break, or evening cocktails with family and friends. The Sandcastle at Bluewater Landing is the perfect home base for your next 30A getaway.The Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Twin BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World-style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
